title: OrderFulfilling v1 payload
description: The order left the pass with a courier (ADR 0019 FULFILLING, entered from READY, delivery only). The milestone ADR 0045 names as the one that replaces the map: a recorded business transition, not something derived from a position. Carries no courier and no customer; a consumer that tells the customer «on the way» resolves the courier's first name through its own authorized port when it renders.
